headline: 181 more dengue patients admitted to hospitals
summary: Rising cases and deaths are creating a significant health risk as hospital admissions continue to climb.
details: An additional 181 dengue patients have been admitted to hospitals, according to recent reports.
The surge in admissions highlights the growing prevalence of the virus across the country.
Health officials are warning of a significant risk as both the number of infections and related deaths continue to rise.
The increase in hospitalizations puts additional pressure on the healthcare system and available beds.
Public health authorities are urging citizens to take preventive measures to stop the mosquito-borne disease from spreading further.

headline: 60 kmph winds: 13 regions at risk of storms as monsoon intensifies
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department has issued warnings for 13 regions, including Dhaka, as temporary storms and thunderstorms are expected.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has forecast temporary storms with winds reaching up to 60 kmph, accompanied by rain or thunderstorms in 13 regions of the country.

Storms with winds up to 60 kmph are expected across 13 regions of Bangladesh, including Dhaka.
